inputs.checklistItemText: Wastewater flow direction not indicated on plan views
inputs.question: Are there wastewater pipes shown on this sheet? If yes, are flow direction arrows (indicating which direction the wastewater flows) shown on the wastewater lines?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether flow-direction arrows are annotated/shown on wastewater lines in the drawing. This is a drawing-element inspection (presence of directional symbols on lines), not a measurement or generic presence check. The two-part question (presence of pipes, then annotation check) is progressive verification, but the core compliance question targets annotation visibility on the drawing itself.
